top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - TB Test (26 TAC §746.901(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregivers  do not have proof of TB test on file.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(I))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the monitoring visit, the playpens were not labeled with the children names. The director labeled the playpens during the visit.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The electronic child safety alarm was observed not functioning in one of the operation's vans used to transport the children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was observed positioned in the hallway to monitor two seperate classrooms during naptime.
